summary: Track 16.10 (Transportation Automation Engine) certified. Backend: all 50 pytest cases PASS (35 static contract locks + 5 pure-function runner tests + 10 live e2e against preview URL including dry-run/live-run, idempotent rerun, runs history, action queue with severity buckets, forecast, health, dispatch read-only visibility, admin auth gate, action PATCH→resolved). Frontend: /admin/transportation/command-queue renders the Command Queue Center with all 3 sub-tabs wired and TX nav 'Command Queue' tab present. Morning Queue shows severity-bucketed sections (urgent bucket with 41 live actions verified). Automation Health shows last-run KPIs + route panels (4 live pilot routes from 16.09, 24 dry-run routes including 16.10 additions); manual 'Dry-run' and 'Run automation' buttons fire and render JSON tx-cq-run-result with all 7 count keys. 30-day Forecast tab renders all 6 sections.
verified_assertions: POST /api/admin/transportation/automation/dry-run -> 200, dry_run=true, returns counts {items_scanned:45, actions_created:0, emails_attempted:0, emails_sent:0, emails_needs_configuration:0, eligibility_updates:0, errors:0}
POST /api/admin/transportation/automation/run -> 200 with structured summary; second consecutive call returns actions_created <= first (idempotent via deterministic event_key)
GET /api/admin/transportation/automation/runs -> count>=1 with triggered_by='admin' on latest run
GET /api/admin/transportation/automation/actions -> {items, buckets} with all 5 severity buckets (blocking, urgent, action_required, advisory, info)
PATCH /api/admin/transportation/automation/actions/{id} {status:'resolved'} flips status and writes audit (test_78 PASS)

GET /api/admin/transportation/automation/forecast -> horizon_days=30, data dict with 6 buckets (inspections_due, orientations_expiring, driver_documents_expiring, carrier_documents_expiring, packets_pending, overrides)

GET /api/admin/transportation/automation/health -> scheduler_enabled=false (preview), routes_live=4 (TRANSPORT_CARRIER_INVITE, TRANSPORT_ORIENTATION_ASSIGNED, TRANSPORT_ORIENTATION_EXPIRING, TRANSPORT_PACKET_NEEDS_CORRECTION), routes_dry_run=24 (includes all 9 new 16.10 routes), last_run populated
Admin endpoints reject unauthenticated requests (test_76 PASS: 401/403)
Static lock: lib/transport_automation.py + routes/transportation_automation.py have ZERO references to twilio/sms_send/fcm/apns (test_21 PASS)
Static lock: dry-run branch does NOT call transport_automation_events.insert_one nor transport_action_items.insert_one (test_34 PASS)
Pure runner: repeated live runs against same fake DB produce 0 duplicate actions (test_51 PASS)
Frontend: data-testid='txnav-command-queue' renders in TX sub-nav
Frontend: data-testid='tx-cq-subtabs' contains all 3 NavLink tabs (tx-cq-tab-queue, tx-cq-tab-health, tx-cq-tab-forecast)
Frontend Morning Queue: severity sections rendered (tx-cq-section-urgent visible with 41 live actions; other severities only render when populated, which is correct empty-state behavior)

Frontend Automation Health: tx-cq-health, tx-cq-health-last (KPIs), tx-cq-health-routes with tx-cq-routes-live (4 routes shown) and tx-cq-routes-dryrun (24 routes shown), tx-cq-run-live + tx-cq-run-dry buttons fire and populate tx-cq-run-result <pre> with structured JSON

Frontend Forecast: all 6 sections render (tx-cq-forecast-inspections_due, tx-cq-forecast-orientations_expiring, tx-cq-forecast-driver_documents_expiring, tx-cq-forecast-carrier_documents_expiring, tx-cq-forecast-packets_pending, tx-cq-forecast-overrides)
critical_code_review_comments: Note for spec-vs-impl naming drift: review request used forecast testids 'tx-cq-forecast-driver_docs_expiring / carrier_docs_expiring / packets_open / overrides_expiring' but the implementation (correctly) uses the canonical backend bucket keys: 'driver_documents_expiring / carrier_documents_expiring / packets_pending / overrides'. The frontend testids match the backend response keys, which is the right behavior. Next testing agent should use the canonical names.
Morning Queue sections render conditionally (only buckets with items appear in the DOM). The 'no actions' empty-state uses data-testid='tx-cq-empty'. This is by design; do not flag as a bug.

Scheduler intentionally disabled in preview (SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false); /admin/transportation/automation/health correctly surfaces scheduler_enabled=false. Manual run/dry-run buttons drive the runner directly, which is the verified path.
